title: PS5 Players Plan Permanent Blackout Protest Impacting GTA 6
description: Irate PS5 players worldwide have started unplugging their consoles in a protest against Sony, aiming to reduce active user metrics. This blackout could impact anticipated titles like GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## PS5 Players Launch Permanent Blackout Protest Against Sony

In an unusual turn of events for the gaming community, irate PS5 players around the world have begun unplugging their consoles in an organized protest against Sony, according to reports from Push Square.

The protest, dubbed a "permanent blackout," requires consoles to remain unplugged indefinitely. While the blackout was technically scheduled to kick off at 7 PM local time, many participants have already started observing it early. The primary objective of this movement is to directly target and reduce one of the Japanese giant's most crucial performance metrics: active users.

## Potential Impact on GTA 6 and Future Releases

As players pull the plug on their hardware to voice their dissatisfaction, questions arise about how this protest might affect the gaming ecosystem. With highly anticipated titles on the horizon, such as Rockstar Games' *Grand Theft Auto VI* (*GTA 6*) and *Marvel's Wolverine*, an extended console blackout could mean players willingly sideline themselves from the ecosystem just as major gaming milestones approach.

While the long-term effectiveness of cutting off active user metrics remains to be seen, the grassroots movement demonstrates a significant level of frustration among the PlayStation community. Whether this will remain a brief statement or evolve into a prolonged movement remains a focal point for industry watchers.

## Editor's Take

It is rare to see players utilize hardware blackouts as a form of protest against platform holders. While targeting active user metrics is a clever way to draw corporate attention, asking gamers to keep their consoles unplugged—especially with monumental titles like GTA 6 on the horizon—is a heavy sacrifice. It highlights a deep-seated friction between players and platform strategies that deserves attention.
